name: 斑尾鵑鳩

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球LC；香港稀少冬候／過境

illustrationTaxon: Macropygia unchall adult male; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 山斑鳩體型較厚、尾較短，頸側有黑白斑塊，翼上覆羽有栗紅羽緣；斑尾鵑鳩體態修長，頸較長，尾特別長且具栗色橫斑，成年雄鳥上體密佈橫紋。
珠頸斑鳩較小且尾較短，頸側深色斑佈滿白點；斑尾鵑鳩身形較纖長、尾顯著較長，翼背與尾具密集栗色橫斑。

featureNotes: 雄鳥頭粉灰，頸後及頸側可見金屬綠光
上體羽深褐並密佈栗色橫斑與羽緣
長尾深褐底具規則栗色橫斑，整體比例突出
雄鳥胸腹偏酒紅色而相對平滑，雌鳥頭喉具細暗橫斑、胸具黑色鱗紋

rangeMap.note: Partial broad native-range country overview: from the western Himalayas and northeast India through Myanmar and Indochina to southeast China, and south from the Malay Peninsula to Flores. Selected countries are broad geographic context only, not nationwide occupancy or exact range polygons; Hong Kong is described separately as a scarce winter/passage visitor.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read: Category I, rare-to-scarce winter visitor and passage migrant in wooded habitats; appears to be increasing. Adult male 37–41 cm, slender with long neck and long barred tail; pinkish-gray head, green nape/neck-side sheen, blackish-brown upperparts densely barred and rufous-fringed, blackish-brown tail barred rufous, vinous-brown underparts. Female duller with fine dark bars on head/throat and black breast scales. In HK records are single birds, mainly Nov–Feb and late Mar–early May; woodland and shrubland favored. Global IUCN LC, stable trend. Range from western Himalayas and NE India through Indochina to SE China and Malay Peninsula south to Flores.

Cornell eBird/Merlin read: shy forest dove with dense understory; dark brown wings/tail, tan-brown body, males boldly barred on chest, bronzy-green nape in both sexes; longer-tailed than Spotted Dove and Turtle Dove; global LC.
Full HKBWS Oriental Turtle Dove account read: 33–35 cm, bulky shorter-tailed dove, adult black-and-white neck-side patch and strongly rufous-fringed upperparts; comparison distinction only.
Full HKBWS Spotted Dove account read: 31 cm, slender but relatively shorter-tailed, dark neck patch with white spots; comparison distinction only.
